The Studio

Irtiqa Hassan Interiors is a luxury interior design and interior architecture studio, planning spaces with utmost precision and executing designs with high-end furniture and finishes.

IHI offers a highly personalised, bespoke service. Strong client relationships come first, and the process is tailored to each client’s needs: a full interior architecture, furniture design and turn-key styling service, from concept to completion.

Be it residential or commercial, the studio creates unique styles, from Modern Luxury to French Parisian.
